request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WORKSHOP

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the green grass and grey stone slab under the house, so the walls and the workbench stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the steep red tile roof, the big light steel-grey cogwheel on the gable, the timber-framed walls, the workbench, outline and art style exactly the same.
